column3: A refresh asks for the refs only and re-clones the pack when the head moved; there is no have/negotiation yet
column4: an unchanged head should cost nothing, and a real incremental fetch is the expensive part of the protocol; the cheap half is worth having now
column5: same repository cloned twice: reused true, 2 requests, 94 KB, 1.4 s, 0 R2 reads and 0 writes; a moved head pays a full clone
column6: kept; the spec says a moved head re-downloads, to be revisited if refreshes matter
